summary: Both labels print organic ashwagandha root extract 600 mg with withanolides 30 mg, fermented ginger and a probiotic blend, positioned for mood and energy. One trial at the same daily amount names primary outcomes and reports them positive, in postmenopausal women (42742071). The nearest purpose, cognition, energy and mood in 39498904, names no primary outcome. The stored trial (23439798) reports lower stress scores and cortisol but its abstract names no primary outcome and no brand. Pooled analyses favor Withania for anxiety and stress with substantial heterogeneity (41140145, 41644067). In a three-arm trial all groups, placebo included, had lower cortisol, the primary endpoint (41815853).
question_for_clinician: Does 42742071 (root extract 600 mg/day, 66 postmenopausal women, primary sleep and menopause outcomes positive) carry to two combination labels positioned for mood and energy, or does 39498904, which has the matching purpose but names no primary outcome? Agent recommendation: no credit from this review, and positive_strong is too strong for one 64-person trial.

limitations: Small, one center. Abstract states no brand or withanolide content. Three primary outcomes with no stated order.

read_not_used.41815853: Compares a proprietary extract (APB, 300 mg twice daily) with a root extract arm whose dose the abstract doesn't state and placebo; primary cortisol fell in all groups.
read_not_used.41635453: 300 mg twice daily for 24 weeks in 100 adults; primary body weight and BMI fell more than placebo. A purpose these labels don't carry.
read_not_used.41561822: Primary Menopause Rating Scale fell more than placebo in 60 women; the abstract states no dose.
read_not_used.41725116: 300 mg twice daily for 8 weeks in 50 elderly adults; primary quality of life scores improved more than placebo. A purpose these labels don't carry.
read_not_used.41943502: Safety trial, 600 mg/day for 8 weeks in 1002 adults; the primary outcome is safety, not efficacy.

stop_or_hold: Both labels add fermented ginger and a probiotic blend; the trials read are of the extract alone. The fields can't express that gap.
